name: What are the benefits of choosing custom cabinets over stock cabinets?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of choosing custom cabinets over stock cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing custom cabinets offers several advantages over stock options. Custom cabinets are built to your exact specifications, ensuring a perfect fit for your space and maximizing storage. You have complete control over materials, finishes, and hardware, allowing for a unique design that reflects your personal style. While often a higher investment, they typically offer superior durability and craftsmanship, potentially increasing your home's value.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom cabinets offer a perfect fit, personalized design, superior durability, and potentially increased home value compared to stock cabinets.
